title.narrative: Civil Society Organizations as Actors of Governance and Development in Jamaica

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen and focus the capacity of CSOs to participate in the

implementation and monitoring of public issues and policies within their communities and

fulfil our role as an essential building block of development and national cohesion. Citizens

have a voice through CSOs to communicate with the government to assist in delivering

services and programmes and hold them accountable through watchdog organisations.
